problem:
Complete the following parametric equations generating the hyperbola $25{x}^{2}-9{y}^{2}=225$ in terms of the parameter $t,$ defined for $t\in [-\pi ,\pi ]$ where $t\ne \pm \frac{\pi }{2}.$

$x=3\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,$
$y=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The parametric equations of a horizontal hyperbola with Cartesian equation

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1
$$

are given by

$$
x=a\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=b\operatorname{tan}⁡t.
$$

First, we rewrite the equation of our hyperbola in standard form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}25{x}^{2}-9{y}^{2} & =225 \\ \frac{25{x}^{2}}{225}-\frac{9{y}^{2}}{225} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{9}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{25} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

So, in our case, we have $a=\sqrt{9}=3$ and $b=\sqrt{25}=5.$ Therefore, the parametric equations are

$$
x=3\operatorname{sec}⁡t,\,y=5\operatorname{tan}⁡t.
$$
